the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Effectiveness makes the support closed by the effective-support lemma; the support is by definition the union over s of the supports of the fibre cycles, whose fibres are therefore the supports of the cycles alpha_s, each of dimension r as a cycle on the fibre; taking the closed support itself as the witness W gives relative dimension r, hence equidimensionality (source lines 1987-1992)
